cases.question: TRUTHINESS_STORE is set to a custom path inside a Git repository. Quote the line that makes it win over the repository's default store location.
A hook payload is valid JSON but has no cwd field. Quote the line that falls back to the current process directory.
decide sent candidates c1 and c2 to the reviewer. The reviewer exits with status 0 and prints ["c1","zzz"], where zzz was never sent. Quote the line that rejects this output.
cases.answer_format: Also return verdict_count, the integer size of the Map that decide returns.

cases.question: A claim has exactly two applicable relations at the query scope and revision, resolving nothing: R1 (supports, event e, observation o-1) and R2 (inconclusive, event e, observation o-2). Quote the line that flags the event as conflicted.
cases.answer_format: Also return result as an object with a status string and a sorted evidence_ids array of strings.

cases.question: review-pending reports its outcome on stdout for the agent to parse. Quote the line that prints it.
A landmark note's claim id already exists in the store. Quote the line that skips that note.
